sentences.text: Fire is the emergency every captain dreads, so start with how it works.
A fire needs heat, fuel and oxygen, plus the chemical chain reaction that keeps it going.
Remove any one and the fire goes out.
Cooling removes heat, smothering removes oxygen, shutting off the fuel removes fuel, and dry chemical agents interrupt the chain reaction.
Fires are classed by what’s burning.
Class A is ordinary combustibles like wood, cushions and line.
Class B is flammable liquids like gasoline and oil, the most common boat fire.
Class C is energized electrical equipment.
